contract: Seven mirrored randomized ABBA/BAAB blocks with equal calibrated iterations per pair, targeting at least 20ms GPU work per round (cap 512). Two warmups/three measured rounds. Each iteration constructs packed B anew, then executes R=1 or R=8 matmuls with shared immutable B and alternating activations; both additionally packs A for every call. Buffers are preallocated private inputs/outputs/workspace. GPU and host intervals include pack dispatches and encoding/commit/wait; allocation/uploads/loading are excluded. All R distinct outputs from the last identical iteration, packed contents/padding/guards and unchanged inputs are independently checked outside timing every round. B packing is never amortized across iterations/rounds; only across the specified R calls. Not complete managed language throughput or full numerical/safety qualification.
